ItemID: unavailable; Title: SABRENT 10 Port 60W USB 3.0 Hub with Individual Power Switches and LEDs Includes 60W 12V/5A Power Adapter (HB-BU10); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to connect my USB networking adapters and other peripherals; the powered ports and individual switches seem useful, though ten ports may be more than I need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: SABRENT 4 Port USB 2.0 Data Hub with Individual LED lit Power Switches [Charging NOT Supported] for Mac & PC (HB-UMLS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: USB 2.0 could limit my USB 3.0 Ethernet adapter, so I would pass on this hub.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: PNY 128GB Turbo Attache 3 USB 3.0 Flash Drive, GREY; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It is a practical accessory, but I have no immediate file-transfer or portable-storage need.
